Key Advantages

Why Buy Milky Mushrooms?

Milky Mushrooms (Calocybe indica) are uniquely suited to Indian cooking and climates, delivering premium quality unmatched by standard button mushrooms.

14-Day Long Shelf Life

Unlike other varieties, Milky Mushrooms can stay fresh in the refrigerator for up to two weeks without losing flavor.

Meaty Texture & High Quality

Known for their firm, thick white caps and meaty texture, they absorb flavors beautifully, making them excellent in curries.

100% Organic & Chemical-Free

Grown using locally sourced organic straw substrate without any chemical pesticides, artificial fertilizers, or bleach.

Direct From Farm Delivery

Harvested fresh in the morning and delivered directly to your doorstep in Dindigul, Palani, and Kodaikanal.

Nutritional Powerhouse

Health Benefits of Milky Mushrooms

Incorporate our farm-fresh Milky Mushrooms into your weekly meals to experience their dense profiles of protein, minerals, and dietary fibers.

Doctor Approved

High fiber and low glycemic index make them ideal for diabetics.

Rich in Plant Protein

Contains 3-4% high-quality protein (dry basis 25-30%) with all essential amino acids, making it a perfect meat substitute.

Boosts Immunity (Beta-Glucans)

Packed with active beta-glucans and polysaccharides that strengthen immune cells and help fight off infections.

Low Calorie & Heart Healthy

Zero cholesterol, low fat, and low sodium. Rich in potassium and fiber to regulate blood pressure and digestion.

Rich in Vitamin D & B-Complex

One of the few organic non-animal sources of Vitamin D, essential for bone health, alongside Riboflavin and Niacin.

Cultivation Lifecycle

Our Eco-Friendly Farm Process

We monitor each stage of the lifecycle closely under strict sterile and organic standards to guarantee a premium harvest.

01

Substrate Straw Sterilization

Paddy straw is soaked and steam-sterilized to destroy pathogens, ensuring a pure medium for organic cultivation.

02

Spawning & Inoculation

High-quality Milky Mushroom grain spawn is layered with straw in bags and incubated in dark rooms for colonization.

03

Casing Layer Application

Fully colonized bags are topped with a sterilized, moisture-holding clay soil casing layer to induce fruiting.

04

Fruiting & Harvesting

Bags are placed in high-humidity cropping rooms. In 10-15 days, beautiful milky white caps are hand-harvested.
